name: loupe
description: Screen recorder with scroll-to-zoom for demo videos
author: akshatgg

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -O -parse-as-library src/native/Sources.swift -o bin/sources && swiftc -O -parse-as-library src/native/Capture.swift -o bin/capture && swiftc -O src/native/InputTap.swift -o bin/inputtap && swiftc -O -parse-as-library src/native/Render.swift -o bin/render
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
